/docs/faq:
Dash explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Dash address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Dash targets one block every 157.5 seconds. Dark Gravity Wave adjusts difficulty every block. The block subsidy decreases by approximately 7.1% each year.

1 DASH = 100,000,000 duffs. Fee rates use duff/B. Fiat values use the provider's Dash prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

The transaction and address views show the transparent chain. Dash special transactions include masternode registrations, quorum commitments and Platform withdrawals. Withdrawal fees come from their special payload, not input minus output values.

The pending list contains transactions observed in a node notification feed since this explorer connected. It is not a complete pending pool and does not predict confirmation time.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Responses carry observation and stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

GET /api/blocks/tip/height
GET /api/block-height/100000
GET /api/block/00000000000fd08c2fb661d2fcb0d49abb3a91e5f27082ce64feed3b4dede2e2/txs
GET /api/tx/836f0f697b6d3a6283c7c264a5a144c893e7b077ef4aea87dbb4f32d81ac86c5
GET /api/address/XrgrCXZFhLNfyR4UKv9YT19CK7YVEPrc8Y/txs
GET /api/address/:address/txs/chain/:last-confirmed-txid

Live updates: WebSocket /api/v1/ws with action init, Blocks poll every15 seconds; recent transactions are a sample from the notification stream.

/about:
dash.tx.taxi - Dash block and mempool explorer
A tx.taxi explorer built from mempool/mempool
About dash.tx.taxi

dash.tx.taxi is the Dash explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, recent mining activity and pending transactions observed by one Dash node while using a Dash-specific tx.taxi identity.

Dash-native data

Values are denominated in DASH, duffs, or the selected fiat currency. Fee rates remain duff/B, transaction sizes use bytes, and all block, address, mining, concepts shown by the interface retain their Dash meaning.

Dash Core coverage

Historical blocks and indexed address histories come from Dash Core data. InstantSend observations are shown separately from block confirmations. ChainLock status is not supplied by this provider. Platform state and identities are outside the Core transaction index.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Dash network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

Project links

Contact the tx.taxi maintainer
/privacy-policy:
Privacy Policy
Updated: September 20, 2026



Use Your Own Node When Privacy Matters

dash.tx.taxi displays public Dash chain and mempool data through the backend configured by the site operator. For independent verification and the strongest network privacy, use your own Dash node and explorer.



Request Data

Normal website and API requests can reveal standard web metadata to the operator, including your IP address, user agent, requested URL, and request time. Server logs may be retained for reliability, abuse prevention, and debugging.



Local Preferences

Display preferences such as theme, denomination, fiat currency, language, and timezone may be stored in your browser. dash.tx.taxi does not require an account for ordinary explorer use.



Public Blockchain Data

Dash transactions, addresses, scripts, and blocks are public. Looking up an address or transaction can associate that lookup with your network metadata. Do not treat a public explorer as a privacy boundary.



External Links

This site links to tx.taxi contact channels, Dash documentation, and upstream source code. Those external services have their own privacy policies.



Open Source Attribution

Mempool names, logos, and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners; dash.tx.taxi is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V.
/terms-of-service:
Terms of Service
Updated: September 20, 2026



Informational Explorer

dash.tx.taxi provides a view of public Dash blocks, transactions, addresses, mining data, fee estimates, and mempool state. It is an informational service, not a wallet, exchange, custodian, payment processor, or transaction-priority service.



No Control Over Dash Transactions

The operator cannot reverse, cancel, accelerate, recover, or redirect a Dash transaction. For wallet, exchange, or payment issues, contact the service that created or received the transaction.



Data and Availability

Explorer data may be delayed, incomplete, unavailable, or different from another node's view. Fee estimates are estimates only and do not guarantee confirmation. The service is provided as-is without a promise of uninterrupted availability or fitness for a particular purpose.



Acceptable Use

Do not abuse the website or API, interfere with service operation, bypass reasonable rate limits, or use the service unlawfully. Access may be limited when necessary to protect availability.



External Services

This site may link to tx.taxi contact channels, Dash references, upstream source code, and infrastructure dependencies. External websites have their own terms and policies.



Open Source

dash.tx.taxi is derived from mempool/mempool. Contact t.me/hiss for the current reviewed fork source package.
/trademark-policy:
Trademark & Attribution
Updated: September 20, 2026



tx.taxi Identity

dash.tx.taxi is an independently operated Dash explorer in the tx.taxi family. Its domain, wordmark, chain palette, and service identity distinguish this fork from the upstream project.



Upstream Attribution

This software is derived from The Mempool Open Source Project. The upstream source code, visual system, project names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.



No Affiliation

dash.tx.taxi is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V. References to mempool.space and mempool/mempool are nominative attribution to the software from which this fork derives.



Dash

Dash is an open network and protocol. References to Dash, DASH, duffs, blocks, transactions, addresses, mining, and InstantSend describe the network data presented by this explorer.
